verdict.rationale: Canny offers a REST API and MCP server for LLM-based interactive workflows, but there is no evidence of a CLI, headless mode, or CI/automation-oriented interface for running Canny actions in pipelines. The MCP server is described as sign-in based (interactive), not built for headless CI use, and OpenAPI/API docs probes returned 404s, suggesting no clear programmatic API surface documented for automation.
